# Goody — account brief

## Who
Goody is a gifting platform for sending personal and business gifts without needing an address ([source](https://ongoody.com/)). The GitHub org ongoody lists the company as Goody with the site ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is checked into ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 11 public repos and 64 followers ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).
- goody-app was last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)).
- The iOS app has 5,400 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).
- There were 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@ongoody-maintainer-1), top contributor to ongoody/goody-app with 96 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). Their profile lists company "Goody" and website https://ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). No title or location listed.
- Maintainer Two (@ongoody-maintainer-2), 40 commits to ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). Their profile lists company "Goody" and website https://ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). No title or location listed.
- @ongoody-maintainer-3, 12 commits to ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-3)). The profile record lists no name, company, or bio.

## Why now
goody-app was last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)), and there have been 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). The app is on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Addressed to Maintainer One (@ongoody-maintainer-1), top committer on goody-app, written for the Staff React Native Engineer persona.

You have 96 commits in goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)), which builds through EAS on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json), [source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)). There are also CI workflows in the repo ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and 4 App Store releases went out in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). When a fix needs to reach those users, does it go out over the air on a channel or wait for the next store build?
